header.systemBanner: This is an automatic readiness check Heimdall ran on the benchmark's tasks, not a comparison you started.
header.systemBannerAgent: This is an automatic agent check Heimdall ran, not a comparison you started.
header.systemBannerDrift: This is an automatic drift monitor run: a small test Heimdall re-runs on a schedule to catch an agent or model silently getting worse. It is not a comparison you started.
header.detailsHint: Technical details: test recipe fingerprint, when it was frozen, and which scores are shown.
header.practiceHint: Practice mode: no real model is called, results are scripted and it costs nothing. Use it to try Heimdall out.
header.subtitle: Runs two setups (A and B) on the same tasks and tells you which one is better.
header.deleteConfirm: The comparison, its runs, traces and results are deleted. This cannot be undone.
header.deleteBusy: Stop the comparison or wait for it to finish before deleting it.
header.deleteAdminOnly: Only admins can delete a comparison.

headline.invalid: Test was broken: fix it and re-check
headline.invalidWhy: Test was broken: {{why}}. This is not the agent's fault; fix it and press Re-check.
headline.setupsLeader: {{leader}} is ahead of every other setup

summary.partialHint: The result is worked out once every run has finished.

why.fidelity: the model gateway answered {{n}} of {{m}} runs of setup {{arm}} with a different model than the one asked for (model check)
why.coverage: only {{o}} of {{n}} runs of setup {{arm}} were graded
why.gate: the {{gate}} check fired in {{n}} of {{m}} runs

score.title: Score
score.hint: One setup scored on its own. There is no second setup, so there is no better or worse here; run a comparison to get one.
score.noInterval: Range not known: too few tasks with graded runs
score.bounds: If the {{count}} ungraded runs had all failed or all passed: {{lo}} to {{hi}}
score.invalidHint: Some runs broke for reasons that have nothing to do with the agent, so the score is not trusted. Fix it and run again.

next.ship: Use {{arm}}. Export the report to share it.
next.holdRegressed: Keep {{arm}}. Open the runs where the new setup failed.
next.holdViolations: Hold off. A safety rule or safety check failed; review it below.
next.no_decision: Not enough evidence yet. Compare the runs that differ, or add more tasks.
next.fix_harness: The measurement broke, not the agent. Check the failed runs, fix the problem, then re-score.
next.setupsTied: Not enough evidence to pick one setup. Add more tasks; more tries per task do not help.
next.setupsLeaderFlagged_one: Hold off: {{leader}} broke a safety rule on {{count}} task.
next.setupsLeaderFlagged_other: Hold off: {{leader}} broke a safety rule on {{count}} tasks.
next.partial: Wait for the runs to finish; this page updates as they do.

summary.costUnknown: Not known: this model has no price set
summary.inconclusiveHint: Not enough evidence to pick a winner. Run more tasks.
summary.invalidHint: Something went wrong while measuring (not the agent's fault). Fix it and re-check.
